title: Back Up and Restore KV Store Data
objectives: Back Up and Restore KV Store Data
Verify actual state through a separate inspection or query.

tasks.instruction: The fixture supplies a verified v7_verified data snapshot, followed by a deliberate replacement with CORRUPTED data. Inspect both before restoring.

Restore v7_verified on sh01 using KV Store or splunk restore kvstore -archiveName v7_verified. Advance replica ticks and verify the original checkout/auth owners on all members. Inspect the separate before-restore safety snapshot; it must retain the changed data.

hints: Inspect running versus disk source and use the correct component.
Keep the fixture clock paused and advance deliberately to observe transitions.
